title: Quick start
description: Create a docs repository from the template, start the dev server, and see your first page in under five minutes.

sections.title: Create your repository
paragraphs: Use the GitHub template so your docs start with a clean history. The new repository holds only your brand and content; you can pull template improvements later.
sections.code:
gh repo create my-app-docs --template smeltery/quire --public --clone
cd my-app-docs

sections.title: Start the dev server
paragraphs: Flox pins Bun, pre-commit, and the linters. The first activation installs dependencies and the git hooks.
sections.notice: No Flox? Install Bun 1.3 or newer, then run bun install and bun run dev.

sections.title: Check before you push
paragraphs: The same command runs in CI and in the pre-commit hook. It formats, lints, type-checks, tests, builds, validates Markdown and diagrams, and enforces size budgets.
